text.title: AI-Assisted Development — Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the AI-assisted dev workflow record: named `inputs[]` entries for the `tool_task_map` (all seven task classes, each with tool and review checkpoint), the `block_list` (the eight minimum security-critical areas with paths and policy), `context_files` per tool, the `exclusion_file` for secrets and data, `tool_retention` checks, the `prompt_template`, the `ai_assisted_label` with auto-merge disabled; a decision; evidence; and a review whose outcome compares defect escape, revert rate and two-week churn for AI-assisted versus other PRs and tightens the map when worse. Validator in scripts/validate-ai-assisted-dev.py enforces it, including context-file coverage and the tighten-when-worse rule.

required.field: `name`, `repo_url`, `record_version` (semver, bumped whenever the map is tightened)
the engineer accountable for the map and the cadence review, `role:handle`

named entries: `tool_task_map` (seven task classes, each `tool` and `checkpoint`), `block_list` (eight minimum areas, `paths[]`, `policy`), `context_files` (one per tool in the map with a path and review date), `exclusion_file` (path and excluded patterns), `tool_retention` (per tool: terms checked, source), `prompt_template` (path), `ai_assisted_label` (label and `auto_merge_disabled`) (r-tool-to-task-map-written, r-security-critical-block-list, r-repo-context-file-maintained, r-no-secrets-or-customer-data-in-prompts, r-structured-prompt-four-blocks, r-ai-diff-reviewed-like-human-code)
one sentence stating which task classes are AI-assisted with which tool, and which are ai-off
at least one URL: the context file, the exclusion file, the retention terms, the cadence comparison (r-defect-rate-tracked-ai-vs-human)

`cadence` (monthly | quarterly), `next_review_at`, `last_outcome` null or the comparison: `period`, `ai_assisted` and `other` each with `defect_escape_rate`, `revert_rate`, `churn_2w_rate`, `worse_on[]`, `map_tightened`, `action`, `url` (r-defect-rate-tracked-ai-vs-human)

forbidden.pattern: `tool_task_map` missing a task class, or `block_list` missing any of authentication-session, authorization, cryptography-keys, payments-billing, pii-processing, secrets-config-loading, production-iac, database-migrations — fm-ai-everywhere-no-map

a block-list entry with `policy` other than `ai-off` or `two-reviewers-non-prompter`; `data-migration` or `infrastructure` in the map with a checkpoint weaker than two reviewers — fm-confident-insecure-default
`prompt_template` not naming a four-block template, or a tool in the map with no `context_files` entry or one reviewed before the last cadence — fm-prose-prompt
no `exclusion_file`, or `tool_retention.terms_checked: false` for a tool the map still uses — fm-secrets-in-the-prompt
`review.last_outcome.worse_on` non-empty with `map_tightened: false` or no `action` — fm-churn-nobody-measures
a map entry with `tool: ai-off` and a checkpoint other than `ai-off`, or the reverse — r-tool-to-task-map-written
`review.cadence` missing or `last_outcome` recording no numbers for both groups — r-defect-rate-tracked-ai-vs-human

list.item: `tool_task_map` covers all seven task classes with a tool and a checkpoint each; `ai-off` tool and checkpoint agree (r-tool-to-task-map-written).

`block_list` covers the eight minimum areas with paths and a policy of ai-off or two non-prompter reviewers; data migrations and infrastructure sit at two reviewers or ai-off (r-security-critical-block-list).
Every tool in the map has a `context_files` entry reviewed within the last cadence (r-repo-context-file-maintained).
`exclusion_file` excludes secrets and data directories; every tool's retention terms are checked or the tool is ai-off (r-no-secrets-or-customer-data-in-prompts).
`ai_assisted_label` is set and auto-merge is disabled (r-ai-diff-reviewed-like-human-code).

`review.last_outcome` compares defect escape, revert and two-week churn for both groups; any `worse_on` entry comes with `map_tightened: true`, an `action` and a bumped `record_version` (r-defect-rate-tracked-ai-vs-human).

Dependency verification and the break-the-function test check are applied per PR through the checkpoint matrix, not recorded here (r-verify-introduced-dependencies-and-apis, r-ai-tests-must-assert-and-fail-when-broken).
